original_method: Verify target and CX7 topology, open the protected BMC Web Sensor List, enumerate the four chip resources without relying on a literal range query, capture filters, pagination and refresh context, map every member to its adapter/port/chip, compare complete fields to the approved SPEC, optionally corroborate the same telemetry through a supported backend, and preserve evidence without clearing logs or changing thermal controls.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal `sensor get 'TEMP_CX7_1~4_Chip'` does not enumerate four resources, the `head -100` fallback can omit members, and the requested TEMP_UBB_BACK evidence is the wrong Source Identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the protected Web UI to enumerate and capture all four explicit CX7 chip sensor names. If approved, query each exact backend resource separately with complete untruncated output and prove it represents the same UI data.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The BMC-Web/SPEC inspection and 3/3-minute estimate remain; generic log clearing, literal-range assumptions, truncation and unrelated sensor substitution are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an expected adapter/port/chip-to-sensor matrix first, then attach complete rendered identity, reading, units, health, thresholds, timestamp, freshness and SPEC result for each of the four members.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic set completeness, topology binding and freshness evidence to the generic Web/SPEC check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A visually plausible set of temperatures can still be incomplete or mapped to transceivers, the wrong adapter, or a duplicated UI row.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor numbering may not equal UI display order; mapping must come from the approved platform definition rather than inference.

The following transceiver case and duplicate UBB-back case remain independent. Any backend-only substitute requires an approved UI-equivalence decision.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Web procedure and SPEC criterion consistently target the CX7 chip temperature family. The generic clear direction and DeepSeek's unrelated UBB-back expectation are method/reference defects, not competing source coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The four-member topology, SPEC and protected UI are identifiable package inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if the chip resources cannot be distinguished from transceiver/other telemetry after the normal package request.

review_improvement: Prevents a wildcard-like query, truncated listing, next-row transceiver data or duplicate-row UBB sensor from falsely satisfying the four-chip Web validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A sensor family's completeness and semantic identity cannot be inferred from a label range. CX7 controller-chip junction sensors and transceiver module sensors represent different thermal locations and limits, while UI ordering may not follow physical topology. Acceptance therefore needs four explicit members, authoritative physical mapping, fresh complete Web fields and per-chip SPEC comparison.
